name: MT8 Bisonte, electric 4WD estimate

cg_height_above_chassis_datum_m.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Virtual low-mounted electric mass layout: CG 65 mm above the supplied chassis underside datum, reduced from the original 95 mm estimate. RCV handling launch tests at 5.2 Nm/wheel and 120 rad/s found 95 mm flipped, 80 mm stayed upright and 65 mm retained more pitch margin. Hull and rendering offsets are derived from this CG; mass and CG-relative inertia remain estimates. This is not a measured battery layout, and the 125 mm ride-origin dimension is not a CG measurement. See docs/research/rc-monster-truck/RCV-handling/README.md.

drive_torque_per_wheel_nm.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Equal-torque electric 4WD approximation; RCV handling revision raises stall torque from 4.2 to 5.2 Nm per wheel. See docs/research/rc-monster-truck/RCV-handling/README.md.

brake_torque_per_wheel_nm.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Nominal mean per-wheel capacity; four times this value is the total brake torque budget, allocated by brake_front_fraction. RCV handling tests at 11.87 m/s found 2.0 Nm pitched over, while 1.2 through 1.65 Nm stopped in similar times; 1.35 Nm retains pitch margin with 85/15 axle allocation. See docs/research/rc-monster-truck/RCV-handling/README.md.

brake_front_fraction.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Fixed virtual axle brake allocation: 85 percent front, 15 percent rear, preserving four times the nominal per-wheel torque budget. Chosen from RCV handling tests to reduce premature rear lock; no yaw or slip feedback. This estimated independent-axle brake arrangement is not a measured Traxxas or central-driveline specification. See docs/research/rc-monster-truck/RCV-handling/README.md.

drive_torque_fade_rad_s.source: Engineering estimate for an electric 4WD simulation baseline; no physical weighing, spring, tire, torque, or handling measurements were supplied. Linear torque fade reaches zero at this wheel speed; 0.100 m tires imply 12 m/s unloaded rolling speed and the four curves imply 624 W peak mechanical power. This is not a measured motor curve, battery model or guaranteed road speed.
